_comment: Typical published United award level per destination region and cabin, ONE-WAY per leg (SFO⇄destination; the UI doubles it for roundtrip deltas). DERIVED FROM OBSERVED DATA, not hand-guessed.
_method: median across destinations of each destination's modal (most frequent) observed price, per region+cabin. The median step keeps one route with many dates — e.g. Air India files SFO⇄India business at 220k on most days — from dragging the whole region's baseline.
_caveat: United partner award pricing is close to FIXED in premium cabins, so those cabins essentially never fall below baseline. Economy is the only cabin with real price variation. This is a property of the award chart, not a bug. For premium cabins the scarce resource is AVAILABILITY, not price.
_note: Oceania has no Business or First availability at all in the observed window, so no baseline exists for those cabins. India routes (AI) price business far above the East Asia level; the median keeps the Asia J baseline at the typical non-India level.
_regenerate: Recompute from data/deals.json after a refresh if the award chart changes.
